shared_elements: dense fields of script-like signs arranged in columns/blocks
figures shown frontally/in profile with elaborate headdress
raised relief carving with figural and glyphic zones combined
framing bands enclosing the figural scene
justification: Both surfaces combine relief human figures wearing tall/elaborate headdresses with extensive fields of block-like script signs arranged in columns beside and around them, which is a genuine but broad correspondence. They differ sharply in specifics: A shows a radiant disc with ray-arms extending to a pair of figures adoring an offering table, while B shows a single frontal figure encased in dense scrollwork and mask motifs on a free-standing shaft, with no disc, no offering, and utterly different proportion and ornament conventions.
